name: Latona
source:
Latona is a military officer that works under the guidance of Lieutenant [url=https://vndb.org/c29770]Prosper[/url] who is one of the two protagonists in the story. In their spare time, she is also being trained to work as his sex-slave and she takes directly all of his commands.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=17]MangaGamer[/url]]
